scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/prerender.tsx --outDir .prerender && node scripts/prerender.mjs

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html README.md
